messages:
maya: Heads-up: drafting a focused beta plan for tenant retention + evidence export + BYOK support. Need clear launch criteria and owners so Sales can recruit pilots.

rachel: Love it. Keep hosted-only for beta. Pilot ask: 5y retention + signed export bundle. Customer wants proof-of-origin metadata.

tom: Eng constraints: can ship per-tenant TTLs + streaming export in ~8wks if we scope to hosted and drop on-prem in v1. Key work: snapshotting and incremental export.

ivan: Sec: require detached manifest signatures and an HSM-compatible KMS matrix. Threat-model: key-escrow compromise + export-replay.

grace: Ops: need retention-cost estimator in Console and per-tenant budget caps. Also quota throttle for exports >100GB/day.

legal-bot: Legal reminder: export must include chain_of_custody (actor, reason, hold_id, timestamps) and an auditable release workflow. NDA required for pilot legal-hold tests.

maya: Proposed minimal beta launch criteria:
- API/UI: per-tenant retention profiles (hot/warm/cold/hold)
- Export: streaming signed bundle (manifest + chunk signatures)
- BYOK: hosted KMS grant + wrapped-key import flow
- Console: cost preview + quota controls
- Docs: SOC2/ISO mapping + export schema
Owners: Eng=Tom, Security=Ivan, Ops=Grace, Legal=legal-bot, PM=Maya.

ci-bot: Checkpoint created: retention/playbook/beta-6732100000 (automated).

maya: Next: Eng estimate by EOD Fri, Legal to draft manifest schema, Sec to sketch threat model, Ops to prototype cost widget.
